whyItMatters: A hardcoded secret key signs sessions and tokens, so anyone with repository access can forge them, and rotation requires a code change.
actions: Generate a new random secret and store it in the environment or secret manager.
Replace the literal with a lookup that raises on startup when the variable is missing.
Rotate out the committed value and purge it from history if it ever protected production.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and the app refuses to start without the variable set.
